lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: US-003 is the only one of the five sites with no stale-sibling pruning

nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 closed the reviewer's CRITICAL finding (scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt) that writeCodexInstructionsFile (src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts:445, US-003, CAM-510 site 3 of 5) only ever reaped INSIDE its own <agentName>/<pid> leaf directory, so a supervisor process that dies/is killed before reaching a dispatch terminal orphans its whole pid leaf (up to 200 KB of the user's git diff) forever -- empirically reproduced by the reviewer with a planted 3-day-old sibling pid dir that survived a second dispatch. Root cause: reap-before-write only ever cleans a resource the SAME live process is about to overwrite; it can never recover another (possibly-dead) process's abandoned resource. Fix mirrors the exact shape US-001 (ship-pr-tempfile.ts) / US-002 (embedded.ts) / US-005 (task-prompt-file.ts) already use one level UP from the write site: added `pruneStaleCodexInstructionsPidSiblings(agentDir, ownPidDirName)` to backend-adapter.ts, scoped at `tmpdir()/cam-cli-codex-instructions/<agentName>/` (the agent-level parent, one directory above the existing <agentName>/<pid> leaf), skipping the calling process's own pid dir unconditionally and removing any OTHER pid-named entry whose mtime exceeds `STALE_CODEX_INSTRUCTIONS_PID_DIR_AGE_MS` (60*60*1000ms, matching the other four sites' 1h threshold). This new prune call runs unconditionally at the top of writeCodexInstructionsFile, BEFORE the existing own-leaf reap-all-before-write (which is unchanged and still correct for the single-owner-per-agent+pid case). No signature changes to writeCodexInstructionsFile or removeCodexInstructionsFile (both keep their existing (agentName, uuid[, pid]) shape), so worker-dispatch.ts/plan-runner.ts's US-R1-001 wiring (removeCodexInstructionsFile now called at every real dispatch terminal) is untouched and still correct -- this story only adds a defense-in-depth prune for pids that never reach that terminal at all. New test file test/supervisor/codex-instructions-stale-siblings.test.ts (mirrors test/supervisor/task-prompt-root-bounded.test.ts's stale-sibling shape: plant an old-mtime sibling pid dir via utimesSync, drive a real CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv dispatch, assert the stale sibling and its leftover file are gone while the calling process's own pid dir and any YOUNGER sibling survive) -- 2 new tests, both real-I/O against a TMPDIR-redirected scratch root (createTestTmpdir, never importing node:os's tmpdir directly, per GOTCHA 14/CAM-510). All gates green: typecheck clean (bunx tsc --noEmit, 0 errors), full bun test 6095 pass / 0 fail (372 files, up from 6093/371 pre-story -- the 2 new tests), full bun run check:all spine green with NO file-size ceiling raise needed (backend-adapter.ts grew ~35 lines but stayed under its existing budget). No vendor/templates changes, so embed-vendor:check ran clean as part of check:all with nothing to regenerate. Appended one patterns.md bullet (US-R1-002, CAM-510) distinguishing reap-before-write (bounds a live process's own accumulation) from sibling-pruning-at-the-parent (recovers a dead process's abandoned resources) as a general design lesson for any future fixed-parent-temp-dir site. scripts/cam/prd.json is untouched by this story (passes:true writes are supervisor-owned).
